name: Molniya
best_known_for: Russian high-latitude HEO comms — 12-hour Molniya orbit (~600 × 40,000 km) at 63.4° critical inclination, apogee locked over the Northern Hemisphere
credit: Molniya-1 launched 1965-04-23 from Baikonur. The 12-hour HEO at 63.4° exploits J2 apsidal lock to keep apogee dwelling over high-latitude users where geostationary satellites sit too low on the horizon. The line continued through Molniya-1/2/3, Oko early-warning, and the Meridian comms successor still in service today.
